evidence.observation: LH1-C14 requires “a run at the response and roster ceilings, with the retained-file cap raised to fit, completes.” D4 sets the roster ceiling to 4,096, response ceiling to 1 MiB, and retained-file ceiling to 64 MiB. A response for each roster section can make the captured response table roughly 4 GiB. reading.py:190-192 retains each response in an attempt, and :503-514 retains attempts in payloads. The retained-file cap cannot be raised enough for that run.

concerns.recommendation: Allow this combined ceiling case to refuse before the first producer call, as the r4 fix requested, or change the storage and cap contract so the case can complete and replay.
concerns.title: LH1-C14 cannot complete at the combined ceilings

evidence.observation: The plan says “The whole-repository `uv run ruff check` exited 1 at `4ad0d216`” and that the re-sync making it pass “is committed with this plan.” It also sets “Start condition: `main` at `4ad0d216`.” That exact start commit cannot contain the later re-sync required by the phase lint gate in project.md:129-132.

concerns.recommendation: Name the post-sync main commit as the start condition, or state the sync as a prerequisite before LH1 and update the start condition accordingly.
concerns.title: The exact start commit fails the required lint gate

evidence.observation: The contract says “Every attached row of an admitted assertion is kept.” LH3-C4 instead says “a row between two assertions is kept only when both are admitted.” A row naming an admitted assertion and a rejected assertion is attached under the plan's role-based definition but must be dropped under C4 and the ruled exclusion at lines 288–290.

concerns.recommendation: State the rejected-assertion exception in the LH3 goal and attached-row contract, then make LH3-C1 and C4 test that same rule.
concerns.title: LH3 promises to keep a row that its criteria require dropping

response.summary: Fixes 1 and 4–12 address their r4 findings. Fix 2 conflicts with the stated start commit; fix 3 adds a ceiling criterion its caps cannot satisfy. LH3 also has contradictory row-retention criteria.
